## What changed

List the character, component, claim or asset IDs affected. For imports, identify the upstream revision and explain how to reproduce the selection.

## Evidence and rights

Link the exact record, passage, or glyph group that supports each factual change. Identify adapted wording, original contributions, and asset-specific terms.

## Learner impact and review

Describe what a Japanese learner will see and which readings, shapes, or locales the change covers. Identify stale translations and reviews that need renewal.

## Verification

Give the validation command, result, and tested commit. A maintainer runs manual PR validation on the submitted head before merging.
